memo: Cropping terminal to read grep output for play-and-exit. Expect uncommented 'play-and-exit=0'. If the command never ran (no output/prompt only), retype it. If grep shows nothing, insert play-and-exit=0 right after the [core] section header via: sed -i '0,/^\[core\]/s//[core]\nplay-and-exit=0/' ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc. Do NOT save VLC prefs afterwards (would overwrite).
